'''Talen Horton-Tucker''' (born November 25, 2000) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played college basketball for the [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State Cyclones]].

==High school career==
Horton-Tucker played at [[Simeon Career Academy]] where he helped the Wolverines to three-straight City Championships.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://chicago.suntimes.com/sports/simeon-beats-orr-for-third-straight-city-championship/|title=Simeon beats Orr for third straight city championship|work=[[Chicago Sun-Times]]|date=2018-02-18|access-date=2019-01-18|language=en}}</ref> 

A four-star recruit in [[ESPN]]'s ranking,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/230690/talen-horton-tucker|title=Talen Horton-Tucker - Basketball Recruiting - Player Profiles - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2019-01-18}}</ref> he committed to [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]] in October 2017, choosing the Cyclones over schools such as [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] and [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://247sports.com/Article/BREAKING-Iowa-State-lands-commitment-from-4-star-Chicago-guard-Talen-Horton-Tucker-109492093/|title=Iowa State lands Chicago prospect Talen Horton-Tucker|work=247Sports.com|access-date=2019-01-18}}</ref>

==College career==
Horton-Tucker declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]] after his freshman season. A few days later teammate [[Lindell Wigginton]] declared also.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26417903/iowa-state-horton-tucker-declares-draft|title=Iowa State's Horton-Tucker declares for draft|work=[[ESPN]]}} </ref>
